Section 3.4.4 and Appendix C describe how Inner Monologue can provide a streaming TTS or streaming ASR system by simply changing the delay it uses between text and audio tokens [1]. In particular, we train a streaming TTS model by delaying audio tokens by 2 seconds, giving some lookahead to the text tokens, and teacher forcing text tokens at inference [1]. Similarly, we train a streaming ASR model by delaying text tokens by 2 seconds, allowing the model to listen to audio content before generating text tokens [1].

We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention" (Figure 2) [1]. The input consists of queries and keys of dimension dk, and values of dimension dv [1]. We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values [1].
